title: Amateur Surgeon
notes: On an ARM64 Android 16 phone, New Game, tutorial and saw selection worked. A swipe along the yellow guide produced an aligned first incision, score 6 and the next rib-cage instruction. The older touch offset did not recur for this cut. The rest of the operation, other tools, zoom/pan, audio, saves and sustained performance remain untested.
